title: BVSSH Health Canvas
description: Better Value Sooner Safer Happier health, written by /mycelium:bvssh-check. Added 2026-08-31 from a consumer finding: validate_canvas.py reported this file as 'no schema - parse-checked only', while hooks/session-start.sh reads `last_assessed` from it every session to compute overdue-ness. A canvas a hook depends on had nothing pinning the field the hook reads. Permissive on the five dimension blocks - their metric sets are product-type specific and legitimately vary - and strict on `last_assessed` alone, the same split dora-metrics.schema.json uses and for the same reason.

last_assessed.description: Date of the most recent BVSSH assessment, ISO-8601 (YYYY-MM-DD), or null for never assessed. READ VERBATIM by hooks/session-start.sh, which passes it to datetime.fromisoformat. THIS IS WHY THE FIELD IS PINNED: on any parse failure that hook falls back to an age of 999 days and reports the check as overdue, so a malformed or wrongly-typed value is indistinguishable from a genuinely stale assessment. null is explicitly allowed and reports as 'never assessed', which is a different and honest state.
